Natural Language Processing Certification

Welcome to the Natural Language Processing (NLP) Certification Course at the School of Core AI. Master essential NLP concepts, techniques, and advanced applications to analyze and understand human language effectively.

Get practical experience with industry-leading tools and frameworks, including NLTK, spaCy, Transformers, and cloud services like AWS Comprehend and Google Cloud NLP.

Book a session
Inquire Now

Skills you'll gain in the Natural Language Processing Course

Enquire Now : +91 96914 40998

Perks of Our NLP Specialization

Text Cleaning & Preprocessing

Learn tokenization, stemming, lemmatization, stopword removal, and vectorization techniques.

Text Classification & Sentiment Analysis

Build NLP models for binary/multi-class classification, spam detection, and emotion analysis.

Embeddings & Transformers

Understand word2vec, GloVe, BERT, and how to fine-tune transformer models for NLP tasks.

Sequence Models

Build RNN, LSTM, GRU architectures for sequence labeling, translation, and text generation.

Named Entity Recognition & QA

Implement NER pipelines, extract answers from documents, and build QA bots.

Real NLP Projects

Build resume parser, topic modeler, chatbot, and document summarizer with Hugging Face.

Hands-On with Hugging Face

Use pre-trained transformers from Hugging Face with PyTorch and TensorFlow.

Interview-Focused Curriculum

Includes case studies, dataset handling, and typical NLP interview questions.

MLOP's Program Overview

Machine Learning Specialization course offered by the School of Core AI immerses learners in the essential principles and advanced machine learning practices. This comprehensive course covers fundamental concepts, including data preprocessing and feature engineering, vital for transforming raw data into actionable insights. Learners will gain the expertise to leverage machine learning techniques across a broad spectrum of applications, fostering their ability to innovate and drive progress within the artificial intelligence domain.

As the demand for skilled professionals in machine learning continues to rise, this specialization provides the critical education needed to excel in this dynamic and rapidly advancing field. Participants will emerge with the knowledge and capabilities to effectively navigate and contribute to the evolving landscape of AI.

Who Is This Program For?

Aspiring Data Scientists

Aspirational candidates with zero experience who are willing to jumpstart their careers in data science with machine learning.

Recent Graduates

Anyone who wants to get acquainted with machine learning and data science as a software developer.

Career Changers

People who are looking to switch career paths for an AI and machine learning career.

Tech Professionals

Data analysts who wish to superimpose data science with machine learning into their career.
